paragraphs.text: Sedgemoor is a vast bayou surrounding the Witherbloom campus of Strixhaven University on Arcavios . It is home to a variety of strange swamp creatures, including undead animals, crocodilian beasts, trudges, and bogroffs, many of which exhibit eerie necroluminescence. The swamp is a rich source of magical components such as herbs, fungi, spider silk, and pests used in potions and spells. Although it can be treacherous, Sedgemoor is a frequent site for student expeditions and fieldwork.

Encompassing the entirety of Witherbloom College's campus, Sedgemoor is a wild and marshy expanse of shallow waters, islets, and towering fungi. The mana in Sedgemoor is thick and old and swampy. It gathers in the water and the swamp beasts that fill the place. The swamp teems with wildlife both natural and supernatural, including decomposing bayoustriders, marsh-dwelling bogroffs, and giant bats. Necroluminescent undead give the swamp an otherworldly glow at night, making it as beautiful as it is unsettling. While hazardous terrain, venomous creatures, and patches of quicksand pose challenges, Sedgemoor is considered a routine and essential training ground for Witherbloom students gathering field materials.
Locations on the map are marked with a letter and number
Central Islet (S3) - the largest landmass in the local swamp, home to two research sheds and an ancient tree stump.
East Islet (S6) - a spell component collection site; inhabited by poisonous snakes .
Marsh Banks (S1) - the edge of the swamp where wooden docks extend over the muddy water; usually used for storing rafts and punts.
North Research Shed (S5) - a gathering area for Witherbloom students and faculty during bayou classes.
South Islet (S2) - one of three islets where students collect spell components; contains an area of quicksand on its west side.
South Research Shed (S4) - storage space for research supplies and harvesting kits for moss and fungi.
Underwater Spring (S7) - bubbling spring north of a small islet.
